definitions: a_{n,m}=((1-Lambda(m))/m)L_{n-1}^{(1)}(log m), m>=2; R_n(M)=sum_{m=2}^M a_{n,m} in natural m-order.

claims.statement: If Q_n^{end}=max_{2<=M<=X_n}(-R_n(M))_+, then (-R_n(X_n))_+ <= Q_n^{end}. Therefore an upper bound on an endpoint-inclusive excursion is at least as strong as the same one-sided endpoint lower-bound obligation; it is not a strictly local surrogate by algebra alone.
proof: X_n is one of the indices in the maximum.

claims.statement: For every strict cut 2<=Y_n<X_n, R_n(X_n) >= -Q_n(Y_n)-G_n(Y_n,X_n), and therefore S_{2Lambda}(n) >= -Q_n(Y_n)-G_n(Y_n,X_n)-|E_n(X_n)|.
proof: Combine the two inequalities and S_{2Lambda}=R_n(X_n)+E_n with E_n>=-|E_n|.

claims.statement: Let D_n(Y_n)=|S_{2Lambda}(n)-R_n(Y_n)| whenever the natural-order suffix is defined. Then S_{2Lambda}(n)>=-Q_n(Y_n)-D_n(Y_n). Thus if D_n(Y_n) is already controlled at a root-negligible scale, a correspondingly strong all-index upper bound on Q_n immediately yields the same root-sensitive one-sided endpoint control; if no such complement control is available, Q_n alone cannot glue to the endpoint by this inequality. Cutting strictly before the endpoint therefore relocates, rather than removes, the missing root-sensitive obligation unless the complement is discharged independently.
proof: The final strength statement is conditional on the separately specified root-excluding threshold and makes no RH claim by itself.

difference_witness.construction: Fix a finite ordered prefix through Y with all partial sums 0. Path A has zero suffix to X. Path B has the identical prefix but one suffix increment -H_n followed by zeros. Then Q_n(Y)=0 for both, while terminal values are 0 and -H_n; taking H_n=e^n makes the endpoint separation non-polynomial.
difference_witness.establishes: Q_n(Y) does not algebraically determine the endpoint on the ambient ordered-path representation when the suffix is unrestricted.
difference_witness.does_not_establish: The hostile suffix is not claimed to be realizable by the fixed von Mangoldt/Laguerre arithmetic sequence; this is not a target-domain arithmetic counterexample.

r5_shadow_use.premise: The R5 shadow cutoff X_n has a superpolynomially negligible E_n(X_n).
r5_shadow_use.use: Only to split the complement D_n(Y_n) into finite suffix behavior through X_n plus an external shadow-negligible tail.

root_scope.statement: Coffey binds S_{2Lambda} into the Li-coefficient prime/Laguerre coordinate and Voros supplies the contrasting RH-false non-tempered Li behavior. This candidate does not prove that any particular Q/G/D bound holds.

falsification.target: endpoint-inclusive Q as genuinely weaker local statistic
strict-interior Q alone as Li-gluable statistic
path-space witness as target arithmetic DifferenceWitness

residual: RH-ANA-003g: choose a cutoff/statistic for which the complement can be proved unconditionally small by information genuinely independent of the root-sensitive endpoint, or produce a target-domain applicability witness; otherwise rotate away from cutoff-running-excursion family.
